proposal.observation: Round 2 was rejected after correspondence_f1@15 fell by 0.104184. Its after image contains additional oblique detections, but prompt locations changed only modestly; simultaneously, depth_nan_ratio and sam_fill_rate returned exactly to their start values rather than retaining the accepted round-1 values. The final proposal therefore needs to carry the complete accepted incumbent configuration, not another partial overlay.
proposal.rule: Restore every parameter from the accepted round-1 incumbent, then make only a conservative opposite-direction adjustment to oblique-line acceptance. Because the permissive round-2 trial was rejected, slightly tighten the oblique Hough threshold while preserving the accepted gap, pattern, SAM, and upstream settings.
proposal.failure_mode: Primary: stage_4_detection.f_spurious_lines, with an execution-level risk that a partial overlay fails to preserve the accepted upstream state. The added permissive oblique detections did not improve prompt quality and coincided with sharply worse correspondence.
proposal.rationale: This full overlay preserves the only configuration demonstrated on this subset to improve score, correspondence, and depth completeness while keeping ring_count_error at zero. Relative to that accepted incumbent, only hough_threshold_oblique changes from 27 to 30, a small in-bounds tightening intended to reject weak extra oblique candidates without disturbing the accepted max-line-gap or fallback geometry. The round-2 outcome was joint with an apparent upstream reversion, so no isolated causal effect is claimed. Unfolding is included because stage1_unlocked is true.
